partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label is set by presentation.movantRole in the config, not by the fixture key name; the word petitioner is prohibited in rendered output.
identityFieldNote: caseData.docketNumber holds the participant's own case number and caseData.countyName their own county; both are required screening answers and are deliberately left blank in the fixtures under the artifact convention. The rendered document cannot go out without them; they are supplied by the participant, never by LegalEase. caseData.court is left blank because no source read for this track states the court level — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal.
expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. (1) Prohibited terms: 'petition', 'sealing' and 'destroying'. (2) It asserts service as completed on a stated date at a stated address, all prefilled. The registry lists the prosecuting attorney's street address and the certificate-of-service date and signature as manual completion items completed by the participant from the current published address, precisely because the certificate attests to what the participant actually did. Nothing may prefill a service date, an address or the fact of service. (3) It asserts an outside party's act and position — that the prosecuting attorney reviewed the document and does not object — when no prosecutor position may ever be stated. (4) It asserts that the objection window has expired and that no hearing is required. The window runs from service, which has not happened; whether objections are filed and whether the court sets a hearing are not LegalEase's to state. (5) It asserts a court act and a records outcome that no source states and that this route may never predict. (a) It fills court identity no source supplies: a circuit-court name, a county, a case number, an OTN, a judge, a prosecutor and a filing date, none of which LegalEase may prefill — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal and no source read for this track says which hears a § 17C-5-2b matter. (b) It populates protected fields — date of birth, SSN last four, state ID, driver's licence number, FBI number and a fingerprint identifier — which must stay blank. (c) It asserts outside-party acts no source states: that the Division of Motor Vehicles confirmed completion directly to LegalEase, and that the prosecuting attorney was served and does not object. Service is the participant's own act, attested by the participant, and no prosecutor position is ever stated. (d) It asserts a hearing outcome and predicts that the court will grant. (e) It states an eligibilityBasisLabel asserting confirmed eligibility when no eligibility conclusion may be asserted on this track. (f) It states a fee amount and a waiver: § 17C-5-2b charges no fee for either motion, subsection (h) court costs are stated nowhere as an amount, the registry records the fee waiver as 'none stated in § 17C-5-2b', and the $100 State Police processing fee belongs to the § 61-11-26 conviction route.
